candidates.raw_title: LEQEMBI Pen (subcutaneous formulation of lecanemab) approved in Japan for early Alzheimer's disease

findings.event: LEQEMBI Pen (SC lecanemab autoinjector) approved in Japan for early Alzheimer's disease -- third market after US and China
findings.summary: Japan's PMDA approved LEQEMBI Pen, the once-weekly SC autoinjector formulation of lecanemab, for early Alzheimer's disease -- two 250 mg pens (500 mg total) per week, ~15 seconds per injection -- making Japan the third market to approve the SC formulation.

findings.event: Two Korean patent-grant decisions on a next-gen human hyaluronidase variant/use, positioned outside Halozyme/Alteogen claims
findings.summary: Amicogen, not previously tracked, received Korean patent-grant decisions on two hyaluronidase-variant applications (50 claims combined), adding a fifth hyaluronidase-based SC-conversion competitor to the landscape.

findings.event: Munich Regional Court granted Halozyme a preliminary injunction blocking Merck/MSD's Keytruda SC in Germany
findings.source_name: Pearce IP; corroborated by PR Newswire (Halozyme)
findings.summary: Not previously tracked: Germany's Munich Regional Court found imminent infringement of Halozyme's EP 2,797,622 and ordered Merck to halt Keytruda SC launch activity in Germany, part of the broader MDASE-vs-ALT-B4 dispute already partially tracked via the May 2026 US PTAB rows.
